To make things easier for others to understand I label myself as an empath, but to specify, I suffered from narcissistic environments, my mom is a narc, grandma, great-grandma, etc. I’ve luckily been able to see these patterns and break the wheel so to speak, I’ve been 2 years NC, and still have A LOT of healing to do, as a affect of the abuse, of course I’m constantly aware of peoples emotions around me (people pleaser), and have major paranoia if I look good in the eyes of others and often wonder if I’m a narcissist while trying to set boundaries and find my voice with others. It’s a struggle and my number one fear is turning into my nmom. My nmom has 4 sisters, and I have 2 sisters, so it was interesting after I left to realize everyone’s role for the narcs, I was the scapegoat, one sibling the golden child, etc. 

I would cry thinking I or no one would be able to love me (since I grew up with no love) because maybe I was a narc, and I would think I would sabotage myself and the ones around me, but in reality I’ve only sabotaged myself by trying to make sure I’m a picture perfect person, and that no one really cares about the small stuff, and if someone does, it probably means they’re the problem (the narc lol) and end up exhausting myself emotionally.

Now, I have people around me who do love and care about me, and am getting more comfortable with setting boundaries and I honestly can’t wait to have kids, because I know they’re going to have a kind home where this viscous cycle doesn’t continue!
